## v1.1.0

Fixes to the desk stand from test prints. **Reprint both the head and the box:** a head from
v1.0.0 won't go into a v1.1.0 box.

- **The box's top band is 1.1 mm all the way round.** At the corners it used to pinch to 0.3 mm,
  too thin to print, and came out broken. The head's corners are rounder to match.
- **The collar's underside slopes at 45°**, and the box's band has a matching ramp it sits on,
  so the collar no longer sags when printed.
- **The speaker/mic opening is clear.** The rim had blocked the U-shaped notch in the front
  shell's edge; it now has slots there. The back plates get the same slots.
- The box meshes are clean everywhere (one had a small non-manifold edge).

| Part | File |
|---|---|
| Desk stand head, with collar | `amoled18_stand_head.stl` |
| Desk stand head, without collar | `amoled18_stand_head_no_collar.stl` (needs a box exported with `collar_h` 0) |
| Boxes | `amoled18_stand_box_103035_edge.stl`, `amoled18_stand_box_802525_flat.stl`, `amoled18_stand_box_104050_end.stl` |
| Back plates | `back_plate_103035_1000mAh_edge.stl`, `back_plate_802525_400mAh_flat.stl`, `back_plate_104050_2400mAh_end.stl` |
| Hole plugs | `amoled18_hole_plugs.stl` |

Screws: 4 × M2 × 5 socket head (display to the collar head; M2 × 4 for the other head and for the
back plates), 6 × M2 × 8 countersunk (head to box).

How to print and put it together: [PRINTING.md](https://github.com/jeffmhopkins/esp32-s3-touch-amoled-1.8-case/blob/v1.1.0/PRINTING.md)
